Chapter 697: Chapter 6: Exaggerated Accumulation Speed Of World-Breaking Origin Force (Seeking Subscriptions)_3

Chapter 697: Chapter 6: Exaggerated Accumulation Speed of World-Breaking Origin Force (Seeking Subscriptions)_3

According to the degree of separation from their own insights into the Fusion Rules, Supreme Beings formed different guiding paths.

Merely from the Second Realm to the guiding path, the impact on Supreme Beings wasn’t very significant—they could regain their cultivation by continuing to comprehend for a few thousand years.

If it were a Third Realm guiding path, it would significantly affect the Supreme Beings, needing at least several tens of thousands of years of re-comprehension to recover.

A Fourth Realm guiding path was the limit a Supreme Being could recover from. If it were a Fifth Realm guiding path, the stripped Supreme Being might as well give up on that Fusion Rule.

“What exactly is the origin of this black planet that compels a Supreme Being to pay such a price?” Lin Yuan secretly thought.

No, not right.

...

Not one Supreme Being.

Perhaps twelve Supreme Beings.

Because there were twelve black gates on the black planet.

Each black gate corresponded to different pillar-level Fusion Rules, such as the Life and Death Samsara Rule of the Fourth Realm guiding path that Lin Yuan could currently see.

The ultimate rewards of the other eleven black gates were likely similar.

“Never mind.”

“I will begin comprehending now.”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts and immediately started observing the rules of life and death around him.

[Your understanding is Against-Heaven, viewing the essence fusion of the life and death rules significantly boosts your comprehension of the Life and Death Samsara Rule…]

Merely after a brief moment of comprehension, Lin Yuan felt the bottleneck that had once trapped him dissolving. At this moment, the Life and Death Samsara Rule seemed like it had switched to easy mode for him.

“Based on my current speed of comprehension, in at most fifty years, I can elevate the Life and Death Samsara Rule to the Second Realm,” Lin Yuan’s eyes sparkled.

Fifty years?

For a Tenth Rank Evolver, fifty years pass in a blink.

Tenth rank Evolvers who wish to train up to the Tenth Rank Summit and achieve pillar-level Fusion Rules don’t know how many tens of thousands of years it would take, eventually elevating the pillar-level Fusion Rules to the Second Realm… This bottleneck has trapped a large number of Tenth Rank Summit Evolvers.

The previous Nalan, as well as seasoned Grade A Tenth Rank individuals like the Black Star Lord and Lustrous Star Lord, were also stuck here.

Even for Lin Yuan, who possessed Against-Heaven’s Understanding, it would probably take several hundred years to cultivate the Life and Death Samsara Rule to the Second Realm.

But now, just fifty years?

That is to say, as long as Lin Yuan wishes, he could try breaking through to Tier 11 after fifty years.

“What a major opportunity…” Lin Yuan’s mind was exhilarated.

This formation of the Fusion Rules guiding path, involving the levels of Supreme Beings, had only been heard of by Lin Yuan so far, and he had never seen it.

Within human civilization, there might be similar opportunities, but it would definitely require queuing.

For instance, inside a black gate on the black planet, only one life could be admitted at any one time.

For example, currently, an incarnation of Lin Yuan was comprehending the guiding path of the Life and Death Samsara Rule. Even if other Tenth Rank Evolvers passed the test behind the gate, they would have to wait until Lin Yuan finished his comprehension before they could enter.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

A smile also appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

“Lucky I let my incarnation go in.”

“Otherwise, if it was an avatar, it might have been trapped there for quite some time.”

Lin Yuan was in a good mood, even though having a complete guiding path, he knew that elevating the Life and Death Samsara Rule to the Fourth Realm would also take quite some time.

If the Taiyin Primordial Spirit had entered that door, Lin Yuan estimated that he would be unable to use that divine spirit’s combat power for a long time.

After all, during the period of comprehending the Fusion Rules guiding path, once you leave, you can’t continue to go in, which was a price Lin Yuan found hard to accept.

“Now, the incarnation is there perceiving the Life and Death Samsara Rule.”

“Both major divine spirits can still be used, which is the best outcome.”

Lin Yuan thought for a while, then took out the Mysterious Gourd, inverted its mouth, and condensed a drop of purple liquid.

Since stepping into the Tenth Rank, having endured a massive Chaos Void Origin Infusion, Lin Yuan’s flesh, Inner World, and soul had all surged several levels.

This led to a rapid increase in the absorption of the purple liquid inside the Mysterious Gourd.

It was estimated that it wouldn’t take long before he could completely absorb the purple liquid, and by then, the direct size of Lin Yuan’s Inner World would reach an unprecedented 2.33 billion square miles.

“Hmm?”

“Has the Taiyang Divine Spirit already reached beneath that Eternal Spatial Rift?”

Just as Lin Yuan was absorbing the purple liquid, his thoughts suddenly stirred, and his gaze turned toward that large Alien Battlefield.

…

Battlefield A098.

Near the central northern region, a thousand-mile wide Eternal Spatial Rift stretched across.

Just then.

A figure appeared silently.

“Eternal Spatial Rift?” Lin Yuan looked up at the thousand-mile wide fissure in the heavens above.

The gray, misty airflow occasionally floated in, emitting fluctuations that made Lin Yuan’s spirit tremble.

The biggest difference between the Eternal Spatial Rifts on the small-sized Otherworldly Battlefield, and those on the medium-sized Otherworldly Battlefield,

is that the ones on a large Alien Battlefield, due to the excessively large torn area, were already allowing some things from beyond the universe to squeeze in.

Such as the body of a Supreme Being that drifted in over a hundred years ago.

Over the long years, many “things” have drifted into the large battlefield through the Eternal Spatial Rifts, though the vast majority are extremely dangerous.

For example, as recorded in human civilization, during the dormant years, the Insect Race and Tianyu Clan opened up a large battlefield with an Eternal Spatial Rift that squeezed in a bizarre life form.

This bizarre life form almost brought an irreversible disaster to the Cosmic Starry Skies. Finally, over ten Supreme Beings had to collaboratively banish this bizarre life form back outside the universe.

There are many such examples, and basically, nine out of ten “things” that drift in through the Eternal Spatial Rift will cause disasters of varying degrees.

“In a large Alien Battlefield, I have to be even more cautious.”

“Aside from facing those Alien Strong Ones, I also need to be vigilant about the changes in the Eternal Spatial Rift at all times.”

Lin Yuan’s expression grew solemn.

But then, a smile appeared on his face.

Because upon arriving at this thousand-mile wide Eternal Spatial Rift,

Lin Yuan had already felt the speed of accumulating World-Breaking Origin Force reaching nearly exaggerated levels.
